event: India's Statement on Industrial Policy abolished industrial licensing for most industries, welcomed foreign investment, allowed up to 51% direct foreign equity in high-priority industries, and proposed MRTP pre-entry-control reform. This is a macro liberalization milestone, not a healthcare- or food-sector PE-specific event.

DPIIT's Consolidated FDI Policy effective October 1, 2010 stated that sectors not listed separately were permitted up to 100% FDI under the automatic route, allowed 100% automatic FDI for construction-development projects including hospitals, exempted hospitals from selected construction conditionalities, and kept retail trading generally prohibited except single-brand retail.

SEBI notified the Alternative Investment Funds Regulations framework; SEBI's release states that AIFs including private equity funds must register and that Category II AIFs include private equity funds, debt funds and funds of funds without specific government or regulator incentives or concessions.

IFSCA's Fund Management Regulations, 2025, as amended up to July 30, 2025, set the current GIFT IFSC FME framework including Authorised FME, Registered FME Non-Retail and Registered FME Retail categories, with non-retail restricted schemes offered by private placement.
Warburg Pincus invested in Max Healthcare; company release states Rs 140 crore in Max Healthcare for 23% fully diluted stake and Rs 340 crore total group exposure.
Apax invested in Apollo Hospitals; Apax portfolio page lists 2007 investment year and realised status.
KKR invested in Radiant Life Care, later important to Max Healthcare combination history.
source: Repository reports L02-L03; requires primary verification

event: TPG completed a Rs 900 crore significant minority investment in Manipal Health Enterprises.
Carlyle Asia Partners IV affiliate bought a stake in Metropolis Healthcare from Dr GSK Velu and affiliates.

NPPA capped coronary-stent prices and then issued compliance, billing-detail and trade-margin memoranda after identifying billing/transparency and availability risks. Later parliamentary answers verify non-stent-component disclosure and monitoring responses, but not a quantified systemwide shift into procedure fees.

NPPA archived tables on the Fortis Memorial Research Institute Gurgaon dengue-patient case listed procurement prices and MRP/billing rates: scheduled formulations up to 343% margin, non-scheduled formulations up to 914%, and consumables up to 1,737%. This verifies a corporate-hospital pricing concern, not PE-specific causation.

PIB/ACC verified that Bhupendra Singh moved from Chairperson of NPPA to Chairperson of the National Authority for Chemical Weapons Convention. Activists alleged industry/hospital-lobby pressure in press reports, but motive is not proven by reviewed primary evidence.
Carlyle agreed to invest for 20% of Piramal Pharma; estimated equity investment about US$490 million.
NHA estimated total health expenditure at 3.83% of GDP, GHE at 1.84% of GDP, and OOPE at 39.4% of total health expenditure.
source: MoHFW NHA 2021-22 PDF and PIB release

event: CCI approved Tata Digital acquisition of up to 64.3% of BigBasket B2B entity SGS and sole control over B2C entity IRC.
API Holdings/PharmEasy agreed to acquire 66.11% of Thyrocare, triggering a SEBI open offer for 26%.
Zomato announced proposed acquisition of Blinkit for INR 45,082 million consideration, positioning quick commerce as a natural extension of food delivery.
Reliance Retail announced acquisition of 100% of METRO Cash & Carry India for Rs 2,850 crore; CCI approved in March 2023.
Temasek signed agreement to acquire additional 41% of Manipal Health Enterprises; Manipal Group about 30%, TPG reinvested 11%, Sheares retained 18%.
Blackstone-backed acquisition of CARE Hospitals and KIMS Health created a large hospital platform; exact stake and value vary by source.
source: Reuters/Financial Express/Debevoise; company-level approval trail later appears in CCI Aster-QCIL release

event: KKR signed definitive agreements to acquire controlling interest in Healthium MedTech from Apax funds.
KKR signed definitive agreements to acquire controlling stake in Baby Memorial Hospital; press reports cite about 70% and INR 2,000 crore.
source: Business Wire mirror and Business Standard; value based on press reports

event: Mankind signed definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Bharat Serums and Vaccines from Advent for about INR 13,630 crore enterprise value.
Mankind completed BSV acquisition for INR 13,768 crore purchase consideration.
Aster DM and Blackstone/TPG-backed Quality Care signed merger agreement to create Aster DM Quality Care with 38 hospitals and 10,150+ beds, subject to approvals.
Swiggy prospectus filed with SEBI; company had no identifiable promoter and significant foreign institutional shareholders including MIH India Food Holdings.
Medi Assist Healthcare Services IPO involved an offer for sale by Bessemer Health and Investcorp Private Equity Fund I, among others.
KKR and HCG announced deal for KKR to acquire up to 54% from CVC Asia V at INR 445 per share, with open offer potentially taking KKR to 54-77%.
source: HCG/NSE press release and Business Standard coverage

event: Temasek agreed/reported to acquire about 10% of Haldiram Snacks Food at about US$10 billion valuation.
source: Reuters reported via Business Standard; CCI filing status should be checked

event: CCI approved proposed Aster-QCIL transaction involving Aster, BCP Asia/Blackstone, Centella/TPG, and QCIL.
CCI approved Jongsong/Temasek acquisition of less than 10% of Haldiram Snacks Food.
CCI approved Alpha Wave/IHC acquisition of 6% of Haldiram Snacks Food and found no AAEC in plausible packaged-food markets.
Torrent announced agreement to acquire controlling stake in JB Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals from KKR at INR 25,689 crore equity valuation, followed by merger.
CCI approved ChrysCapital-related acquirers' proposed acquisition of approximately 84% of Theobroma shareholding and voting rights on a fully diluted basis.
Zepto announced/reported US$450M CalPERS-led funding round at US$7B valuation.
L Catterton announced strategic partnership and investment in Haldiram's.
Aster Q3 FY26 deck says merger expected completion in Q1 FY27, CCI approval received, share swap completed, NCLT process ongoing.

Aster stock-exchange intimation says the joint company petition for the Quality Care/Aster scheme was fixed for NCLT hearing on May 22, 2026; this supports treating the merger as pending final sanction/effectiveness in the current package.
source: Aster official merger page and April 2, 2026 intimation

event: CCI approved proposed acquisition of certain shareholding in Haldiram Snacks Food by L Catterton India Fund.
CCI L Catterton-Haldiram order identifies an advisory agreement giving an L Catterton adviser access to commercially sensitive information and advisory role on strategy, talent, and performance.
CCI approved General Atlantic Singapore BWP acquisition of 6.93% fully diluted stake in Balaji Wafers.
Official BSE shareholding pattern for HCG reports Hector Asia Holdings II Pte. Ltd. at 54.27% as foreign promoter, total promoter/group at 64.21%, and public shareholding at 35.79%.
NHA 2022-23 released: GHE 1.43% of GDP, OOPE 43.4% of total health expenditure, GHE 43.7% of THE.
Blackstone announced sale of its Emcure Pharmaceuticals stake to Bain Capital; press reports cite about Rs 650 crore and Blackstone realised about 2.8x its 2006 investment of about Rs 230 crore.
Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical completed about 74% acquisition of Gland Pharma at about US$1.09 billion; KKR (about 38.4% holder since 2014) exited.

Radiant Life Care (backed by KKR) and Max India agreed to acquire majority of Max Healthcare through Life Healthcare 49.7% stake purchase plus reverse merger; combined entity to operate over 3,200 beds in 16 hospitals.
The Carlyle Group's CA Harbor Investments announced binding agreements to acquire up to 74% of SeQuent Scientific at INR 86 per share via SPAs and open offer.

Manipal Health Enterprises (TPG-backed) completed Rs 2,100 crore acquisition of Columbia Asia Hospitals India (11 hospitals); CCI cleared in January 2021. Made Manipal second-largest Indian multi-specialty chain.
Hinduja Global Solutions announced sale of its healthcare BPO business to Baring Private Equity Asia (BPEA) Fund VIII (via Betaine B.V.) at US$1.2 billion enterprise value.
CVC Capital Partners acquired about 89% of Sajjan India (later renamed Cohizon Life Sciences) at about Rs 7,000 crore valuation.
Sapphire Foods India IPO listed: PE selling shareholders included Goldman Sachs (18.4%), Edelweiss (9.4%), CX Partners (6.5%); OFS-only IPO at Rs 1,180 per share.
Pristyn Care raised about US$96 million Series E and reached unicorn status at about US$1.4 billion valuation; PE/VC investors included Sequoia/Peak XV and Tiger Global.
GIC invested about US$170 million in TPG Growth-incubated Asia Healthcare Holdings (Motherhood, Nova IVF, AINU).
Carlyle Asia Partners V agreed to acquire up to 10% of YES Bank as part of about US$1.1 billion total bank capital raise.

Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan Board announced agreement to acquire significant majority of Sahyadri Hospitals Group from Everstone; 8 hospitals, ~900 beds, ~300 critical-care beds; first OTPP control PE buyout in India.
Sagility India IPO (Rs 2,106.40 crore offer for sale by Sagility B.V., promoter controlled by EQT after 2022 BPEA combination); listed on BSE/NSE Nov 12, 2024.
GIC announced additional US$150 million investment in Asia Healthcare Holdings, bringing combined funding to about US$320 million across Motherhood, Nova IVF and AINU.
Hospitals and diagnostic centres placed on the 100% automatic FDI route (~Jan 2000); the most permanently open of all sectors here, so the FDI cap was never the binding constraint on hospital deals.

Press Note 3 of 2011 moved brownfield pharmaceuticals (foreign acquisition of existing Indian drug makers) to the FIPB/Government approval route over takeover/essential-medicine concerns; greenfield stayed 100% automatic.
Cabinet carved medical devices out of the pharma FDI regime to 100% automatic (greenfield and brownfield), notified as Press Note 2 of 2015.

India-Mauritius Protocol signed (Singapore Third Protocol Dec 2016): source-based capital-gains taxation on Indian shares from 1 April 2017, with grandfathering for pre-April-2017 shares; routing shifted Mauritius->Singapore->GIFT-City.

Brownfield pharma liberalized to 74% automatic / above-74% approval (Press Note 5 of 2016); food-product retail trading (incl. e-commerce of India-made food) opened to 100% FDI (Government route per DPIIT).
NPPA capped coronary stent prices (~85% cut) under DPCO Para 19; knee implants capped 16 Aug 2017; trade-margin rationalization followed (anti-cancer drugs 2019; COVID devices 2021).

IHH Healthcare (Malaysia; ultimate holders Mitsui/Khazanah) acquired ~31.1% of Fortis Healthcare via Singapore SPV Northern TK Venture (~Rs 4,000 crore at Rs 170/share), becoming classified promoter; the largest foreign-control hospital position in India.
US withdrew India's GSP trade benefits (~3,600 product lines) following an AdvaMed (US device lobby) USTR petition over India's coronary-stent and knee-implant price caps.
Temasek (Singapore SWF) agreed to acquire an additional 41% of Manipal Health Enterprises to ~59% control (NIIF fully exited); Manipal later (Feb 2024) sold 8% to Mubadala/Novo Holdings/CalPERS.
BPEA EQT acquired a majority/control stake in Indira IVF (India's largest fertility chain) from TA Associates and the founding family; press ~60%/~Rs 6,000 crore at ~US$1.1bn valuation.

event: Blackstone (US) acquired ~72.5% of Quality Care India (CARE Hospitals) with TPG ~27.5%; QCIL added KIMS Health; later (Nov 2024) announced merger into Aster DM to form a top-3 chain (~10,150+ beds; Blackstone ~30.7% joint control).
evidence_classification: VERIFIED FACT for control; value press-reported

event: CCI cleared Advent International's INR 2,475 crore (12.1%) investment in the merged Apollo HealthCo (Apollo 24/7) + Keimed, fusing India's largest retail pharmacy with its leading wholesale distributor (AHEL retains >=59.2%).

Finance (No.2) Act 2024: LTCG to 12.5%, STCG to 20%, indexation removed (NRIs excluded from relief); buyback taxed as deemed dividend in shareholders' hands from 1 Oct 2024 (applies to non-residents subject to treaty).
KKR (US) agreed to acquire control of HCG oncology from CVC (up to 54% at Rs 445/share); Hector Asia Holdings II held 54.27% by March 2026 with sole operational control.
Manipal (Temasek-controlled) agreed to buy Sahyadri Hospitals from Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (~Rs 5,800 crore), taking Manipal to 49 hospitals — sovereign-to-pension consolidation.
IHH's long-frozen mandatory open offer for an additional 26.1% of Fortis closed with near-zero acceptance (1,778 shares); IHH remained at 31.17% and did not reach majority.
Parliament passed the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Bill raising the insurance-sector FDI cap from 74% to 100% (most provisions in force 5 Feb 2026).
